Rulings

A ruling is a recorded decision: a rule for many words, or a choice on one word where we depart from a dictionary or a source. Each of the {{ruling_count}} below gives its reasons with the evidence, its date, who made it and its status: current, provisional (awaiting a further check) or withdrawn. When a ruling changes, its history says how and why. The general rules behind them are on How we decide.
